cases.name: correspondent banking payment repair
cases.prompt: A regional bank needs a payment repair workspace for operations analysts handling correspondent banking transfers. Analysts must identify malformed SWIFT messages, preserve nostro account evidence, request beneficiary-bank clarification, route sanctions holds to a reviewer, and record the final repair decision. The first release ends when an approved repair is queued for release; it does not send payments or alter core ledger balances.

cases.name: commercial loan covenant monitoring
cases.prompt: A commercial lending group needs a covenant monitoring desk where relationship managers upload borrower financial statements, credit analysts compare leverage ratios against loan covenant thresholds, and portfolio managers review waiver requests. The desk must retain calculation dates, borrower attestations, and escalation evidence. The first release produces a reviewed covenant status and waiver packet; it excludes underwriting decisions, pricing changes, and automated borrower notices.

cases.name: branch cash exception register
cases.prompt: A retail bank requires a branch cash exception register for vault custodians, branch managers, and loss-prevention reviewers. Staff record cash overages, currency strap counts, dual-control witnesses, and camera reference numbers before a manager accepts or rejects the exception. The first release tracks the investigation and approved adjustment recommendation only; it does not post teller transactions, control vault access, or conduct employee discipline.

cases.name: treasury liquidity forecast review
cases.prompt: A corporate treasury team needs a daily liquidity forecast review that combines cash position submissions from subsidiaries, expected debt draws, FX settlement dates, and approved funding assumptions. Treasury analysts prepare scenarios while controllers challenge material variance and the treasurer signs the published outlook. The first release records scenario evidence and signoff; it excludes bank account transfers, hedging execution, and external market data procurement.

cases.name: property claim severity triage
cases.prompt: A property insurer needs a claim severity triage workspace for adjusters, catastrophe managers, and special-investigation reviewers. It must collect first notice of loss details, policy deductibles, repair estimates, fraud indicators, and reserve rationale before an escalation tier is approved. The first release creates a defensible triage record and reviewer queue; it does not settle claims, issue payments, or make coverage determinations.

cases.name: reinsurance bordereau reconciliation
cases.prompt: A reinsurance operations unit needs a bordereau reconciliation workspace for ceded premium analysts, treaty managers, and finance controllers. Users compare ceded premium rows, facultative placements, treaty attachment points, and loss recoverables against monthly partner files, documenting differences and approvals. The first release produces an accepted reconciliation package; it excludes treaty negotiation, accounting journal posting, and reinsurance cash collection.

cases.name: life underwriting evidence intake
cases.prompt: A life insurer needs an evidence intake desk where underwriting coordinators receive attending physician statements, applicant disclosures, lab result references, and producer corrections. Underwriters can request missing evidence and medical directors can mark a record ready for review. The first release manages evidence completeness and provenance only; it does not calculate premiums, approve coverage, or communicate eligibility decisions to applicants.

cases.name: insurance model change governance
cases.prompt: An insurer needs a governance record for changes to catastrophe models used in portfolio planning. Model owners submit version notes, exposure managers attach validation results, actuarial reviewers compare AEP and PML movements, and risk officers approve a release recommendation. The first release preserves review evidence and decision history; it excludes model execution, rating changes, and reserving calculations.

cases.name: sales tax exemption certificate desk
cases.prompt: A multi-state retailer needs a tax operations desk for exemption certificates submitted by business customers. Tax analysts verify jurisdiction, resale certificate status, expiration dates, and legal entity mapping before a tax manager approves an exception. The first release records certificate completeness and approval history; it does not calculate tax, file returns, change invoices, or provide tax advice to customers.

cases.name: transfer pricing documentation calendar
cases.prompt: A global finance team needs a transfer pricing documentation calendar that coordinates country-by-country reporting, local file evidence, intercompany agreements, and fiscal-year deadlines. Regional tax leads assign owners while central tax reviews readiness exceptions and retains supporting schedules. The first release publishes status and evidence readiness only; it excludes tax calculations, legal conclusions, filing submission, and authority correspondence.

cases.name: VAT invoice exception review
cases.prompt: An accounts payable organization needs a VAT invoice exception review queue for invoice processors, tax specialists, and purchasing approvers. The queue must show VAT registration numbers, place-of-supply references, reverse-charge flags, and supplier correction evidence before an exception is cleared. The first release produces an approved correction request; it does not reclaim VAT, post payable entries, or amend supplier invoices.

cases.name: R and D credit evidence binder
cases.prompt: A manufacturing tax team needs an R and D credit evidence binder for engineering managers, payroll analysts, and tax reviewers. It links qualified research activities, wage allocation worksheets, prototype test records, and contemporaneous time evidence to a claimed project. The first release makes evidence reviewable and marks gaps; it excludes credit computation, return preparation, filing, and tax advice.

cases.name: contract obligation extraction review
cases.prompt: A legal operations team needs a contract obligation review workspace for contract managers, business owners, and privacy reviewers. Users capture renewal dates, data processing obligations, service-level commitments, and notice clauses from executed agreements, then route uncertain language for human confirmation. The first release maintains an obligation register and review evidence; it does not interpret legal rights, negotiate clauses, or provide legal advice.

cases.name: litigation hold custodian tracker
cases.prompt: A corporate legal operations group needs a litigation hold custodian tracker for legal coordinators, information governance staff, and department managers. The tracker records hold notices, custodian acknowledgments, data source interviews, preservation exceptions, and release approvals. The first release documents acknowledgment and preservation status only; it does not collect employee data, search documents, decide legal scope, or give legal advice.

cases.name: outside counsel matter intake
cases.prompt: A legal department needs an outside counsel matter intake desk where business sponsors request assistance, legal operations verifies conflict-check completion, and budget owners approve a matter code. The desk retains engagement letters, billing guidelines, matter taxonomy, and intake rationale. The first release creates a complete intake packet; it excludes selecting counsel, authorizing legal strategy, processing invoices, and delivering legal advice.

cases.name: entity management filing readiness
cases.prompt: A corporate legal operations team needs an entity management filing readiness workspace for paralegals, finance controllers, and registered-agent coordinators. It tracks board resolutions, officer changes, annual report due dates, and jurisdiction-specific filing evidence before a coordinator marks a package ready. The first release reports readiness and missing artifacts; it excludes submission, statutory interpretation, entity formation, and legal advice.

cases.name: third party risk assessment intake
cases.prompt: A governance risk and compliance team needs a third party risk assessment intake for procurement sponsors, security reviewers, privacy reviewers, and risk owners. The record must capture inherent risk factors, data classification, subcontractor disclosures, and remediation commitments before residual risk acceptance. The first release produces an approved assessment record; it excludes continuous monitoring, vendor blocking, and automated security scanning.

cases.name: policy exception governance council
cases.prompt: An enterprise compliance office needs a policy exception governance council where policy owners submit exceptions, control owners attach compensating controls, and risk executives record acceptance conditions. The council must distinguish temporary exceptions, renewal requests, expiry dates, and closure evidence. The first release tracks deliberation and approved conditions; it excludes changing policies, enforcing technical controls, and granting permanent privileges.

cases.name: SOX control deficiency remediation
cases.prompt: A public company needs a SOX control deficiency remediation workspace for process owners, internal control specialists, and finance leadership. Users document design deficiencies, operating effectiveness tests, management action plans, and retest evidence before a deficiency is closed. The first release produces a reviewable remediation trail; it excludes testing execution, financial statement certification, and external auditor conclusions.

cases.name: regulatory obligation change register
cases.prompt: A compliance operations group needs a regulatory obligation change register for regulatory affairs analysts, business control owners, and compliance officers. Analysts log a published rule change, map affected obligations, collect implementation attestations, and convene a review when applicability is disputed. The first release records impact assessment and ownership; it excludes legal interpretation, regulatory filing, policy publication, and automated regulatory monitoring.

cases.name: capital expenditure approval portfolio
cases.prompt: A procurement finance team needs a capital expenditure approval portfolio for requesters, sourcing managers, finance business partners, and asset controllers. The portfolio captures business cases, total cost of ownership, supplier quotes, depreciation class, and approval thresholds before a request becomes purchase-ready. The first release generates an approved capital request; it excludes purchase order creation, budget posting, and supplier contracting.

cases.name: supplier onboarding evidence desk
cases.prompt: A procurement organization needs a supplier onboarding evidence desk for category managers, tax operations, information security, and accounts payable. It assembles supplier legal name, beneficial ownership attestation, W-9 or W-8 form, bank detail verification, and onboarding approvals. The first release certifies documentation readiness; it excludes supplier creation in ERP, payment setup, contract execution, and sanctions screening decisions.

cases.name: strategic sourcing bid evaluation
cases.prompt: A strategic sourcing team needs a bid evaluation workspace where procurement leads collect RFP responses, technical evaluators score requirements, finance reviewers compare should-cost models, and business sponsors select a preferred bidder. The workspace preserves conflict declarations and scoring rationale. The first release issues a reviewed evaluation summary; it excludes supplier award, negotiations, purchase orders, and contract signature.

cases.name: purchase order change review
cases.prompt: A manufacturing procurement team needs a purchase order change review queue for buyers, plant requesters, and finance approvers. Users compare original line items, revised quantities, delivery dates, price variance, and supplier correspondence before a change recommendation is approved. The first release captures review evidence and status; it excludes modifying purchase orders, receiving goods, invoice matching, and supplier payment.

cases.name: workforce accommodation request coordination
cases.prompt: An HR operations team needs an accommodation request coordination workspace for employees, HR case managers, workplace services, and managers. The workspace records functional limitation information, accommodation options, interactive process notes, and implementation confirmation while limiting sensitive access. The first release tracks case progress and agreed actions; it excludes medical diagnosis, benefit eligibility decisions, payroll changes, and legal advice.

cases.name: international assignment readiness
cases.prompt: A global mobility team needs an international assignment readiness workspace for HR partners, immigration coordinators, tax mobility specialists, and destination managers. It tracks assignment letters, work authorization status, relocation milestones, host payroll readiness, and employee acknowledgments. The first release reports readiness exceptions and owner commitments; it excludes visa filing, tax advice, payroll activation, travel booking, and immigration decisions.

cases.name: workforce restructuring consultation tracker
cases.prompt: An HR operations group needs a restructuring consultation tracker for HR business partners, employee relations, finance, and regional managers. Users prepare affected-role lists, consultation timelines, selection criteria evidence, severance policy references, and manager attestations for review. The first release records planning completeness and approval history; it excludes selecting employees, issuing notices, calculating severance, and making employment decisions.

cases.name: learning compliance certification register
cases.prompt: A regulated enterprise needs a learning compliance certification register for learners, line managers, training administrators, and compliance reviewers. The register maps mandatory curricula, prerequisite courses, certificate expiration, assessment evidence, and exception approvals to each role. The first release shows certification readiness and exceptions; it excludes course delivery, exam scoring, access suspension, and performance management action.

cases.name: internal audit planning universe
cases.prompt: An internal audit function needs an audit planning universe workspace for audit directors, risk owners, finance leaders, and audit committee coordinators. It consolidates auditable entities, prior findings, risk ratings, regulatory themes, and management requests before the annual plan is recommended. The first release produces a traceable planning proposal; it excludes audit execution, audit committee approval, and management remediation decisions.

cases.name: audit evidence request portal
cases.prompt: An audit team needs an evidence request portal where auditors issue requests, control owners submit artifacts, and quality reviewers verify completeness. Every request must retain population criteria, period under review, source-system reference, and response due date before the auditor accepts evidence. The first release manages request status and acceptance evidence; it excludes direct system extraction, audit conclusions, and report publication.

cases.name: continuous controls alert review
cases.prompt: A finance controls team needs a continuous controls alert review workspace for analysts, process owners, and internal audit observers. It groups duplicate-payment indicators, segregation-of-duties conflicts, journal entry anomalies, and rule version evidence before a reviewer dispositions an alert. The first release records triage and disposition rationale; it excludes transaction blocking, rule deployment, recovery action, and fraud determinations.

cases.name: audit issue validation workflow
cases.prompt: An internal audit organization needs an issue validation workflow for audit leads, management action owners, and independent validators. The workflow captures root cause statements, corrective action milestones, validation test steps, and residual risk commentary before an issue is closed or reopened. The first release preserves validation evidence and final status; it excludes remediation execution, policy approval, and audit rating changes.

cases.name: scope 3 supplier emissions evidence
cases.prompt: A sustainability reporting team needs a Scope 3 supplier emissions evidence workspace for procurement, sustainability analysts, data stewards, and assurance reviewers. It records supplier activity data, emission factors, calculation methodology, and assurance exceptions for a reporting period. The first release makes reported figures traceable and reviewable; it excludes emissions calculation engines, public disclosure submission, supplier scoring, and carbon credit purchases.

cases.name: climate transition plan governance
cases.prompt: A corporate sustainability office needs a climate transition plan governance record for strategy leaders, finance planners, operations owners, and board secretariat staff. The record aligns decarbonization initiatives, capital dependencies, interim targets, and scenario assumptions before governance review. The first release tracks commitments and evidence of review; it excludes target setting, investment approval, emissions forecasts, and external communications.

cases.name: water stewardship site assessment
cases.prompt: A manufacturing company needs a water stewardship site assessment workspace for environmental managers, plant engineers, community relations, and assurance reviewers. Each site records basin context, water withdrawal volumes, effluent quality data, and mitigation commitments before a corporate reviewer accepts the assessment. The first release provides assessment evidence and gaps; it excludes sensor collection, permit decisions, capital projects, and environmental compliance advice.

cases.name: sustainable finance taxonomy eligibility
cases.prompt: A sustainable finance team needs a taxonomy eligibility review workspace for deal teams, ESG specialists, risk officers, and disclosure reviewers. Users attach use-of-proceeds evidence, technical screening criteria, DNSH assessment, and minimum safeguards findings before a classification is recommended. The first release records review readiness and evidence; it excludes investment approval, portfolio labeling, regulatory disclosure filing, and financial advice.

cases.name: enterprise SaaS renewal health review
cases.prompt: A B2B SaaS company needs an enterprise renewal health review for customer success managers, account executives, support leaders, and finance partners. The record combines adoption milestones, contracted entitlements, support escalation history, renewal forecast, and executive sponsor notes before a renewal plan is accepted. The first release creates a shared account review; it excludes billing changes, contract amendments, outreach automation, and pricing approval.

cases.name: SaaS data processing addendum intake
cases.prompt: A B2B SaaS legal operations team needs a data processing addendum intake for sales, privacy, security, and customer procurement contacts. It captures controller-processor roles, subprocessor list requests, transfer mechanism evidence, and security questionnaire references before a reviewer marks the request complete. The first release organizes intake and review status; it excludes contract negotiation, legal interpretation, signature collection, and customer communications.

cases.name: SaaS service incident customer impact review
cases.prompt: A B2B SaaS operations team needs a customer impact review for service incidents involving SLO breaches, tenant impact, support case clusters, and post-incident action items. Incident commanders, support leads, and account teams review evidence before an impact statement is approved. The first release records the internal review and action ownership; it excludes incident response execution, customer notification delivery, root-cause determination, and status page publishing.

cases.name: SaaS marketplace partner compliance review
cases.prompt: A B2B SaaS marketplace team needs a marketplace partner compliance review for partnership managers, security assessors, finance operations, and marketplace governance. The review tracks app permission scopes, data retention statements, revenue-share terms, and support ownership before a partner listing is recommended. The first release produces a reviewed listing packet; it excludes app installation, marketplace publication, payment settlement, and runtime permission enforcement.
